scope: Isolated P4 local proof, not shipping/H0/I1 API

functions.name: propose
functions.arguments:
{
    token: v.string(),
    customer: v.id('payCustomers'),
    service: v.string(),
    price: v.string(),
    setupIntent: v.string(),
    interval: v.union(v.literal('day'), v.literal('month')),
    start: v.number(),
    amountMinor: v.literal(301),
    cycles: v.literal(3),
    currency: v.literal('usd')
}

functions.name: acceptance
accept
prepareCommand
settled
functions.arguments:
{
        token: v.string(),
        id: v.id('recurringCommands'),
        providerRef: v.string(),
        subscription: v.optional(v.string()),
        subscriptionItem: v.optional(v.string()),
        providerEnd: v.optional(v.number())
    }

functions.name: observe
functions.arguments:
{
        token: v.string(),
        id: v.id('recurringCommitments'),
        generation: v.number(),
        subscription: v.string(),
        schedule: v.string(),
        terminal: v.boolean(),
        cancelled: v.boolean(),
        shapeValid: v.boolean(),
        pendingItemsEmpty: v.boolean(),
        cycles: v.array(cycle)
    }

lineIdentity.source: Complete invoice.lines within consistent invoice snapshot
lineIdentity.boundItem: Fresh subscription.items single item captured at activation
lineIdentity.cadence: Core computes exact indices0–2 from shared cadence.ts; line service period, not invoice accumulation period
lineIdentity.eligibility: Core-set immutable first-success receipt flag, with incomplete line identity undecided
lineIdentity.gross: Sum retained unique succeeded receipts across all retained invoices
lineIdentity.recognized: Eligible succeeded receipts, capped301 per unique valid cycle; max903
lineIdentity.reservation: 903 minus recognized while unresolved; never anomalous gross

argumentValidators.planArgs:
{
    token: v.string(),
    customer: v.id('payCustomers'),
    service: v.string(),
    price: v.string(),
    setupIntent: v.string(),
    interval: v.union(v.literal('day'), v.literal('month')),
    start: v.number(),
    amountMinor: v.literal(301),
    cycles: v.literal(3),
    currency: v.literal('usd')
}
argumentValidators.line:
v.union(v.null(), v.object({
    id: v.string(),
    subscriptionItem: v.string(),
    price: v.string(),
    serviceStart: v.number(),
    serviceEnd: v.number()
}))
argumentValidators.cycle:
v.object({
    invoice: v.string(),
    subscription: v.string(),
    period: v.number(),
    amountMinor: v.number(),
    paidMinor: v.number(),
    status: v.string(),
    autoAdvance: v.boolean(),
    payments: v.array(payment),
    lineComplete: v.boolean(),
    lineShape: v.boolean(),
    line,
    billingReason: v.string()
})
